composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate an optional postcode against the city's region before any persistence.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Assign householdId before the identity check so it forms part of the key.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentity

checkIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckUniqueIdentity
  method: service
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: adjustDate

adjustDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AdjustRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyLimit

checkDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCode

assignCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagBulkSignup

flagBulkSignup:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagBulkSignup
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

content.text:
Full build passes. The change is complete.

## Summary

The `customerCode` now follows `<REGION>-<HASH8>`, and every value derived from it moves to the new identity. I touched only two small classes:

**`AssignCustomerCode.java`** — now builds `Locality.region(owner) + "-" + hash8(...)`, where `hash8` is the first 8 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone (already E.164 at this pipeline stage) followed by the last name. Dropped the sequence logic and the `OwnerRepository` dependency entirely.

**`Locality.java`** — `locality(owner)` now returns the REGION segment of the owner's `customerCode` (splitting on the first `-`), falling back to the new public `region(owner)` helper (the former postcode-preferred / city-table derivation) only when no code is assigned yet.

Everything else followed automatically because it already reads `customerCode`:
- **membershipNumber** (`OwnerMapper`: `customerCode + "-M" + yy`)
- **checkDigit** (`CheckDigit` runs Luhn over the digits in `customerCode`)
- **audit record** (`AuditOwnerCreated` logs `customerCode` — verified in the run: `customerCode=NSW-16E6609E`)

No YAML, mapper, or other pipeline files needed changing. Test suite is green.
